How BRAZILINK Works

Local intelligence.
Structured execution.

BRAZILINK coordinates the full real estate investment journey — from investor objectives and curated sourcing to due diligence, negotiation, acquisition and ongoing monitoring.

Explore the methodology ↓
Designed primarily for international investors seeking local access to Brazil.
Central Coordination & Opportunity Sourcing

One point of coordination. A curated local pipeline.

BRAZILINK translates investor demand into clear sourcing criteria, activates its local network and filters the opportunities before they reach the investor.

01

Investor mandate

Segments, regions, ticket, return expectations and risk profile.

02

Network activation

Selected brokers and partners are activated according to the mandate.

03

Market sourcing

Local professionals identify assets and transaction opportunities.

04

BRAZILINK curation

Opportunities are reviewed, filtered and prioritized before publication.

05

Investor access

Selected assets are presented with structured commercial and property information.

The curated pipeline is expected to be refreshed periodically, typically every 15 days.
Strategy, Validation & Execution

From investment thesis to completed transaction.

Each opportunity progresses through a structured journey. Commercial, documentary, technical and financial validation are embedded in the process — not treated as a separate layer.

01

Profile & Strategy

Objectives, capital, timeline, return and risk tolerance.

02

Origination & Curation

Shortlist aligned with the investment mandate.

03

Analysis & Due Diligence

Market, documentation, ownership, risk and technical review.

04

Offer & Negotiation

Price, terms, guarantees, structure and local negotiation.

05

Acquisition & Formalization

Contracts, payments, deed, registration and closing coordination.

06

Management & Monitoring

Leasing, condominium, maintenance, performance and reporting.

Market & LiquidityDemand, comparables, vacancy and exit scenarios.
Asset ReviewTitle, liens, taxes, zoning and physical condition.
Transaction StructureLegal, tax, payment and FX coordination.
TransparencyApproval milestones and investor visibility.
